about.title: Human guidance, real results
about.p1: CareerBridge supports Moroccan and French-speaking talent in their professional projects. We combine European market expertise, local cultural understanding and personalized follow-up.
about.p2: Whether you're looking for a job in Europe or a career repositioning, we build a stand-out application with you.
about.feature1Desc: Every application is unique. No generic templates.
about.feature2Desc: All our services are available in French, Arabic and English.
about.feature3Desc: We measure our success by yours — placement and satisfaction.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: What languages do you work in?
faq.a1: We work in French, Arabic and English. You can choose the language of your deliverables.
faq.a2: Between 48 hours (Refresh package) and 2 weeks (Boost Pro). The exact timeline is confirmed after your order.
faq.a3: Yes, for Pro and Personal Brand packages we offer 2 interest-free installments. Mention this when ordering.
faq.a4: We guarantee a professional-quality application, not the final outcome which depends on many external factors. That said, our placement rate exceeds 70%.
faq.a5: Yes. Your data is processed in accordance with Law 09-08 (CNDP Morocco) and the European GDPR. It is used only to process your order and is never sold.
